explication: VirtualBuddy is a macOS virtualization application. The principal workflow is: a user selects or creates a VM, the application stores it in the VM library, launches a session, configures virtualization, and boots the guest OS. Installation branches through Apple restore-image catalogs or local/custom images, while configuration supports hardware, storage, networking, sharing, and saved states. The sampled code confirms library/session orchestration, catalog loading, storage modeling, saved-state lookup, and guest-folder mounting; several backend links are inferred only from documented capabilities and tree paths.
